examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A short thread in a fixed-height log: the reader's questions at the inline end, the assistant's responses at the start, and follow-up questions after the last one.

examples.name: StartAlignment
examples.summary: The same thread in a narrow panel with every message at the inline start, as a drawer or side panel shows it.

examples.name: LongThread
examples.summary: Twelve turns that overflow the log: it opens at the newest message, stops following when the reader scrolls up, and Scroll to the latest message brings them back.
